# Operation Bifrost (ปฏิบัติการไบฟรอสต์)

> Thai fan-localization collective. Public hub for Thai game-translation mods; the first release is a complete Thai patch for STEINS;GATE (Steam English version), free to download.

Operation Bifrost translates visual novels and games into Thai. Each project lives under its own URL segment, so more titles can be added over time. The flagship release is a full Thai localization mod for STEINS;GATE, built on top of the Committee of Zero English patch — it requires that you already own STEINS;GATE on Steam (English version).

## Projects

- [STEINS;GATE — Thai translation mod](https://operationbifrost.com/steins-gate/): Full Thai patch for the Steam (English) build. Translates the main story, the in-game encyclopedia (Tips), character mails, on-screen CG text, and song subtitles. Free and fan-made; works only on the Steam English version (it builds on the Committee of Zero patch). Linux is supported via the CoZ Polyversal patcher; macOS is untested.
